Show __str__ and __repr__ (dunder methods).

class Book:
    def __init__(self, title, price):
        self.title = title
        self.price = price
    def __str__(self): # for the user
        return f"{self.title} - Rs.{self.price}"
    def __repr__(self): # for the developer
        return f"Book({self.title!r}, {self.price})"
b = Book("Python", 350)
print(b) # uses __str__
print(repr(b)) # uses __repr__
Note: Without __str__, print(object) shows an ugly memory address.
